findings.desc: quality-cleanup: dispatch-usage.ts:333 inline comment contradicts actual behavior — comment says "skip rather than mint a stray orphan attempt" but the code immediately mints a fresh mintCallCorrelation() and continues to write a record. The function-level docstring at line ~312 is accurate ("the final still records but supersedes nothing"); only the inline comment is wrong. Future maintainers working on the null-correlation path will be misled.
